newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 7.62 million barrels in the week ended Feb 28 to 297.78 million barrels from 305.40 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 4.13 million barrels in the week to 236.15 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 603,000 barrels to 106.69 million from 106.09 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.07 million barrels to 37.74 million barrels.
API said gasoline production rose 59,000 barrels in the week to 7.38 million bpd from 7.32 million.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.30 million barrels in the week to 201.82 million barrels from 203.12 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 88.6 percent from 88.8 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 81,000 barrels to 37.57 million barrels from 37.65 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 13.39 million barrels from 13.42 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 41.08 million barrels from 40.71 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.11 million barrels per day from 7.25 million, API said.
